SOP - Drone application of pesticides.one: Standard procedure for spraying pesticides by drone in agriculture, forestry and non-cropped areas (434th RC, 2021).
nums: advance written notice to Gram Panchayat and Agriculture Officer
submit the spray monitoring form after spraying

pts: Only DGCA-certified drones and DGCA-certified pilots
Pilots must also complete the NIPHM pesticide-handling training module
Only CIB&RC-approved pesticides, at approved concentration and height
Calibrate nozzles, check for leaks, mark field boundary and obstacles
Set a buffer zone from non-target crops; keep people and animals out
No flying over crowds, government / military sites, or near airports without permission
Wear PPE; test with plain water first; do not spray when bees are foraging
Use anti-drift nozzles; control height, speed and droplet size
Triple-rinse empty containers; never burn, bury or leave them in the field

watch: Registration for drone use is a separate application to CIB&RC; drone users may use only approved products

SOP - Aerial spraying for Desert Locust.one: Standard procedure for aircraft, helicopter and drone spraying against desert locust, based on FAO guidelines (434th RC, 2021).
nums: spray only within this wind speed
wind shift that means stop and re-plan

pts: Train pilots, incl. clinical effects of insecticides, by locust officer and medical toxicologist
Service aircraft; GPS track guidance; calibrate the spray system
Notify the public 24 hours ahead; residents move livestock and beehives
Full protective clothing for all handlers
Start at the downwind edge, spray crosswind, move upwind; one extra upwind pass
Stop if it rains or is likely to rain
Useful for spot spraying: tall trees, sand dunes, plantations vehicles can't reach

Coronavirus safety tips.one: General COVID-19 safety advice included in the compilation.

pts: Install Aarogya Setu; avoid non-essential travel and gatherings
Keep 6 feet apart; wash hands 20 seconds or use 60% alcohol sanitiser
Disinfect high-touch surfaces daily; cover coughs and sneezes

pts: Chemistry dossier templates (technical, formulation, biopesticides)
